name: Madison River (Upper)
gaugeName: Madison at Kirby Ranch nr Cameron
blurb: The 50-mile riffle. Drift-boat water from Lyons Bridge to Ennis — fast, shallow, and famous.

sections.notes: Float fishing starts at Lyons. Steady riffle, big views, beginner-friendly half day.
Ruby Creek campground is an optional midway takeout. Classic upper-Maddy water.
Full-day riffle. Gradient eases a little; still few eddies. Wind can howl.
Braids and sweeper turns. Eight Mile Ford and Burnt Tree are optional takeouts. No float-fishing below the Ennis highway bridge.
